morphemes.note: 希腊 metron“尺”。英式拼写 metre 与美式 meter 同源，单列以支持 nanometre、kilometre 等拼写校验。
拉丁 natura“天性”< nasci“出生”。-e 结尾形式 nature 用于派生 base。
拉丁 fingere“捏塑”的分词词干 fictus；fiction 取“捏造出来的东西”义。
拉丁 linea“亚麻线、直线”。
拉丁 -aris 经法语 -aire 进入英语，与 -al 分工：多接在含 l 的词干后（linear、solar）。
拉丁 servare“守护、保存”。observe 为“守着看”，preserve 为“事先保住”。
拉丁 odor“气味”。odori 为构词连接形式（odor + -i-）。
古英语 ōþer“两者中的另一个”，日耳曼固有词。
古英语 duru“门”，日耳曼固有词。
拉丁 numerus“数”经古法语 nombre 进入英语，词尾 -b- 为法语插入音；拉丁词干 numer- 见 numerical。
拉丁 aestimare“估价”。英语失落首元音作 estim-。
古英语 hēafod“头”，日耳曼固有词。
古英语 weorc“劳作”，日耳曼固有词。
意大利语 stallo“站立处”，与英语 stall 同源；pedestal < piedistallo。
拉丁形容词后缀 -ester / -estris（pedester、equestris、campester），英语多见于 ped-estr-ian 一类词。
希腊 -ētikos 经拉丁 -eticus 进入英语，构成学科名（phonetics、genetics）或形容词（energetic）。
希腊 physis“自然”< phyein“生长”。
-ate 的过去分词再加 -ed 的合并形式，用于源自拉丁分词的技术形容词。
希腊 pneumōn“肺”< pneuma“气息”。pneum- 为去尾形式（pneumatic）。
拉丁现在分词词尾 -iens / -ientis 经法语进入英语。
希腊 daktylos“手指”；pterodactyl 指翼膜长在特化的第四指上。
古法语 chacier < 晚期拉丁 captiare“抓取”。purchase < purchacier“追求到手”。
古英语 cwic 本义“活的”（the quick and the dead），后转指“快”。
古英语 rǣdan“解读、劝告”，与 rede“建议”同源。
晚期拉丁 realis < res“事物”。
古英语 ceallian“呼喊”，与古诺斯语 kalla 同源。
古英语 hǣtu“热”，与 hāt“热的”同源。
拉丁 pressare（premere 的反复形式）经古法语 presser 进入英语。
古法语 veue“所见”< veoir < 拉丁 videre“看”。
古英语 rinnan“流动、奔跑”，强变化动词。
古法语 torner < 拉丁 tornare“车削”< 希腊 tornos“车床”。
古英语 wrītan 本义“刻划”，故首字母 w 仍拼写但不发音。
古法语 sauf < 拉丁 salvus“完好”，与 salute、salvage 同源。
拉丁 satelles / satellit-“随从、卫兵”，17 世纪起用于“卫星”。
拉丁 publicus < populus“人民”（与 pubes“成年人”有关）。
拉丁 circulus 为 circus“环”的指小形式。
拉丁 finalis < finis“界限、终点”，与 finish、finite 同源。
拉丁 -itivus 由分词词干 -it- 加 -ivus 构成。
拉丁 simplex“一层的、单纯的”< sim-（一）+ plicare（折）。
拉丁 situs“位置”，动词 situs 分词词干为 situ-。
古法语 estandart 本指军旗，后引申为“公认的规范”。
古法语 estorer < 拉丁 instaurare“重建、储备”。
拉丁 studere“热心从事”，现在分词 studens 即 student 的来源。
拉丁 segmentum < secare“切”。
法语 -ique 借入的名词词尾，与英语 -ic 同源但保留法语拼写。
古英语 -þu 名词后缀，接形容词构成抽象名词；true → truth 时去 e。
古英语 grund“底部、地面”，日耳曼固有词。
古法语 paier < 拉丁 pacare“使平息”，本义“偿付以平息债主”。
古英语 tīgan“系、绑”，日耳曼固有词。
拉丁 latus / lateris“边”。与 ferre 的分词词干 lat-（relate、translate）同形异源，切分时须按语义辨别。
拉丁 -igo / -iginis 构成表状态或疾病的名词（vertigo、impetigo、lumbago）。
拉丁 volare“飞”的分词词干 volat-，volatile 本义“会飞的、易散的”。
-ize（希腊 -izein）加过去分词 -ed 的合并形式，构成“已完成某处理”的形容词。
古英语 wealcan“滚动、翻动”，中古英语起专指“步行”。

morphemes.glossZh: 形容词后缀：具有……性质的
morphemes.note: 古英语 -sum 形容词后缀，与 same 同源，表“带有……性质的”。
古英语 wīr“金属丝”，日耳曼固有词；wireless 20 世纪初指“无线电”。
古法语 parfournir“彻底完成、供给”，并非拉丁 forma 的派生，勿按 per- + form 硬拆。
希腊 hodos“道路”。ode 为古希借词中的拼写变体（diode、anode、cathode、photodiode）。
拉丁 claudere“关”。英语动词取 -clude 拼写（include、exclude、occlude、seclude），名词多作 -clusion。
拉丁 cedere“走、让”。英语动词多作 -cede（secede、proceed、recede），名词作 -cession。
ferre“带”的异根分词 latus，英语动词作 -late（relate、translate）。与 latus“边”同形异源。
希腊 prassein“做”经晚期拉丁 practicus；形容词词干作 pract-（practical、practicable）。
拉丁 stare“站”。stant 为现在分词词干（stantis），见 constant、substantiate、distance。

words.etymology: 20 世纪 90 年代机器人学界的首字母缩略词（Simultaneous Localization and Mapping）
derivation: S+L+A+M 四个首字母缩略，作为整体借入，内部不可再切分；词素库记录 slam 这一整体形式
words.example: The drone runs SLAM to map the tunnel as it flies.

words.etymology: nano-（希腊 nanos 侏儒，引申十亿分之一）+ metre（希腊 metron 尺）
derivation: nano（十亿分之一）+ metre（米）→ nanometre；英式拼写 -re，美式作 nanometer
words.example: The coating is only a few nanometres thick.

words.glossEn: engineering of materials at the nanometre scale
words.etymology: nano-（纳米级）+ 希腊 tekhnē（技艺）+ -logia（学科）
derivation: nano（纳米级）+ techn（技艺）+ o（连接元音）+ logy（学科）→ nanotechnology
words.example: Nanotechnology may shrink the sensor to a grain of dust.

words.glossEn: existing in nature, not made by people
words.etymology: 拉丁 naturalis < natura（天性）< nasci（出生）
derivation: natur（出生、天性）+ al（形容词后缀）→ natural
words.example: The cave keeps a natural temperature all year.

words.glossEn: study and treatment of the nervous system
words.etymology: 希腊 neuron（神经、筋）+ -logia（学科）
derivation: neur（神经）+ o（连接元音）+ logy（学科）→ neurology
words.example: The neurology clinic sees many patients with migraine.

words.glossEn: in a pleasant or satisfactory way
words.etymology: nice（古法语 nice < 拉丁 nescius 无知的）+ -ly
derivation: nice（令人愉快的）+ ly（副词后缀）→ nicely
words.example: The two boards fit nicely together after sanding.

words.etymology: nice + -ness
derivation: nice（令人愉快的）+ ness（名词后缀）→ niceness
words.example: Her niceness made the long shift easier.

words.etymology: noise + -less
derivation: noise（噪声）+ less（没有……的）→ noiseless
words.example: A noiseless fan keeps the enclosure cool.

words.etymology: noise + -y，17 世纪
derivation: noise（噪声）+ y（形容词后缀）；去 e 加 -y → noisy
words.example: The gearbox grew noisy after the third run.

words.glossEn: existing in name only; very small in amount
words.etymology: 拉丁 nominalis < nomen（名字）
derivation: nomin（名字）+ al（形容词后缀）→ nominal
words.example: The fee was nominal, so the lab paid at once.

words.glossEn: propose someone for a post or award
words.etymology: 拉丁 nominare（命名、提名）< nomen（名字）
derivation: nomin（名字）+ ate（动词后缀）→ nominate 把名字报上去
words.example: The board will nominate two candidates for the chair.

words.etymology: non-（非）+ fiction < 拉丁 fingere（塑造）的分词词干 fictus
derivation: non（非）+ fict（塑造）+ ion（名词后缀）→ nonfiction
words.example: Her nonfiction account of the flood sold well.

words.etymology: non- + linear < 拉丁 linea（线）+ -aris
derivation: non（非）+ line（线）+ ar（形容词后缀）→ nonlinear
words.example: The sensor response is nonlinear near saturation.

words.glossEn: the ability to judge without personal bias
words.etymology: objective + -ity < 拉丁 obicere（投向）
derivation: ob（朝向）+ ject（投）+ ivity（名词后缀）→ objectivity 把判断投向对象而非自己
words.example: Peer review is meant to protect objectivity.

words.glossEn: watch carefully; also, obey a rule
words.etymology: 拉丁 observare < ob-（朝向）+ servare（守护、留意）
derivation: ob（朝向）+ serve（守护）→ observe 守着看 → 观察，引申为遵守
words.example: Technicians observe the arc through a filtered window.

words.etymology: 拉丁 obstaculum < ob-（对着）+ stare（站）+ -culum（工具、事物）
derivation: ob（对着）+ st（站，stare 的词干）+ acle（名词后缀：事物）→ obstacle 挡在面前的东西
words.example: Cost remains the main obstacle to a wider rollout.

words.etymology: 拉丁 obvius < ob viam（在路上）
derivation: ob（朝向）+ vi（道路，via 的变体）+ ous（形容词后缀）→ obvious 就在路上，一眼看见
words.example: The crack was obvious under the inspection lamp.

words.glossEn: close off or block a passage
words.etymology: 拉丁 occludere < ob-（对着）+ claudere（关）
derivation: oc（ob- 在 c 前的同化）+ clude（关，claudere）→ occlude
words.example: A clot can occlude the artery within minutes.

words.etymology: 拉丁 occurrere < ob-（朝向）+ currere（跑）
derivation: oc（ob- 在 c 前的同化）+ cur（跑，currere；英语拼写中 rr 简作 r）→ occur 跑到面前 → 发生
注意：此处 cur 取“跑”义（currere），与 cura“关心”同形异源
words.example: Errors occur when the battery drops below ten percent.

words.etymology: 希腊 hodos（道路）+ metron（测量）
derivation: od（道路、行程）+ o（连接元音）+ meter（测量仪）→ odometer
words.example: The odometer showed forty kilometres after the loop.

words.glossEn: substance added to give a smell
words.etymology: 拉丁 odor（气味）+ -ant（表物）
derivation: odor（气味）+ ant（名词后缀：物）→ odorant
words.example: A trace odorant makes small leaks easy to smell.

words.glossEn: in a different case; in other respects
words.etymology: 古英语 oþre wisan（以别的方式）
derivation: other（其他的）+ wise（副词后缀：在……方面/以……方式）→ otherwise
words.example: Log the offset, otherwise the next run will drift.

words.glossEn: located or used outside a building
words.etymology: out + door，18 世纪
derivation: out（向外）+ door（门）→ outdoor
words.example: The outdoor test ran from noon until dusk.

words.etymology: out-（超过）+ number
derivation: out（超过）+ number（数目）→ outnumber
words.example: Cheap units outnumber the calibrated ones in the field.

words.etymology: out-（超过）+ perform（古法语 parfournir 完成、执行）
derivation: out（超过）+ perform（执行、表现）→ outperform
words.example: The new model outperforms the old one on noisy data.

words.glossEn: judge something as larger than it is
words.etymology: over- + estimate < 拉丁 aestimare（估价）
derivation: over（过度）+ estim（估价）+ ate（动词后缀）→ overestimate
words.example: Do not overestimate the gain from a single trial.

words.glossEn: costs of running a business; above the head
words.etymology: over-（在上）+ head，18 世纪商业用语
derivation: over（在上）+ head（头）→ overhead 头顶之上 → 不直接产出的一般开支
words.example: Cloud overhead rose once the dataset doubled.

words.etymology: over-（过度）+ work
derivation: over（过度）+ work（工作）→ overwork
words.example: Do not overwork the pump during the first hour.

words.glossEn: measurable factor that defines a system
words.etymology: 希腊 para（旁）+ metron（测量）；现代义经 17 世纪数学拉丁传入
derivation: para（旁、辅助）+ meter（测量）→ parameter 辅助量度 → 参数
words.example: Each parameter is logged together with its unit.

words.glossEn: base that supports a column or statue
words.etymology: 意大利语 piedistallo < piede（脚）+ stallo（站立处）
derivation: ped（脚）+ stal（站立处）→ pedestal；意大利语原形 piedistallo 中的 -i- 弱化为 -e-，现有词素无法严格拼出该元音
words.example: The telescope sits on a concrete pedestal.

words.etymology: 拉丁 pedester（步行的）< pedes（脚）
derivation: ped（脚）+ estr（拉丁形容词后缀 -estris）+ ian（属于……的人）→ pedestrian
words.example: The crossing keeps pedestrians clear of the haul road.

words.glossEn: outer boundary of an area, or its length
words.etymology: 希腊 peri（环绕）+ metron（测量）
derivation: peri（环绕）+ meter（测量）→ perimeter 绕着量一圈
words.example: A fence runs along the perimeter of the site.

words.glossEn: length of time; one full cycle
words.etymology: 希腊 periodos < peri（环绕）+ hodos（道路）
derivation: peri（环绕）+ od（道路）→ period 绕一圈的路程 → 周期、时期
words.example: The test period covers two full heating cycles.

words.etymology: 拉丁 permanens < per-（贯穿）+ manere（停留）
derivation: per（贯穿）+ man（停留，manere）+ ent（形容词后缀）→ permanent
注意：此处 man 取“停留”义（manere），与 manus“手”同形异源
words.example: A permanent marker will not fade in sunlight.

words.etymology: 拉丁 persistere < per-（贯穿）+ sistere（站住）
derivation: per（贯穿）+ sist（站立、停住）→ persist 一直站着 → 坚持
words.example: The error persists even after a full reset.

words.etymology: 希腊 phōnētikos（与声音有关的）< phōnein（说话）< phōnē（声音）
derivation: phon（声音）+ etic（希腊形容词/学科后缀 -ētikos）+ s（学科名词）→ phonetics
words.example: Phonetics explains why the two vowels merge here.

words.glossEn: semiconductor device that turns light into current
words.etymology: photo-（光）+ diode < 希腊 di-（穿过）+ hodos（道路）
derivation: photo（光）+ di（穿过）+ ode（道路，hodos）→ photodiode 让电流单向往光里走
words.example: The photodiode output tracks the laser pulse closely.

words.etymology: photo-（光、摄影）+ 希腊 gramma（记录）+ metron（测量）
derivation: photo（摄影）+ gram（记录）+ metry（测量术）→ photogrammetry
words.example: Photogrammetry rebuilt the facade from forty overlapping images.

words.glossEn: science of matter, force and energy
words.etymology: 拉丁 physica < 希腊 physika < physis（自然）< phyein（生长）
derivation: phys（自然、生长）+ ics（学科后缀，作单数）→ physics
words.example: The physics of the failure is still unclear.

words.etymology: pixel（picture + element 的混成词）+ -ated
derivation: pixel（像素）+ ated（形容词后缀：具有……的）→ pixelated
words.example: The zoomed image looked pixelated at the edges.

words.glossEn: smallest units of a digital image (plural)
words.etymology: pixel 的复数；pixel 为 1960 年代 picture + element 的混成词
derivation: pixel（像素）+ s（复数后缀）→ pixels
words.example: The camera delivers twelve million pixels per frame.

words.etymology: 希腊 pneumōnia < pneumōn（肺）< pneuma（气息）
derivation: pneumon（肺）+ ia（名词后缀：疾病状态）→ pneumonia
words.example: Pneumonia kept the operator off work for a week.

words.glossEn: treatment of foot and ankle disorders
words.etymology: 希腊 pous / podos（脚）+ iatreia（治疗）
derivation: pod（脚）+ iatr（医术、治疗）+ y（学科名词后缀）→ podiatry
words.example: Podiatry solved the gait problem the sensors missed.

words.glossEn: student who continues after a first degree
words.etymology: post-（之后）+ graduate < 拉丁 gradus（步、级）
derivation: post（之后）+ grad（步、级）+ uate（动词后缀：使按级次）→ postgraduate 走完一级之后
words.example: Every postgraduate in the lab rotates through calibration duty.

words.glossEn: following the modern movement in art and thought
words.etymology: post-（之后）+ modern（拉丁 modernus）
derivation: post（之后）+ modern（现代的）→ postmodern
words.example: The essay reads the archive in a postmodern way.

words.glossEn: note added after a letter's signature
words.etymology: 拉丁 postscriptum < post（之后）+ scribere（写）
derivation: post（之后）+ script（写）→ postscript
words.example: A short postscript explains the change of address.

words.etymology: power（古法语 poeir < 拉丁 posse 能够）+ -ful
derivation: power（力量）+ ful（充满……的）→ powerful
words.example: A powerful fan clears the fumes in seconds.

words.glossEn: concerned with doing rather than theory
words.etymology: 晚期拉丁 practicus < 希腊 praktikos（善于行动的）< prassein（做）
derivation: pract（行动、做）+ ical（形容词后缀）→ practical
words.example: A practical fix beat the elegant model again.

words.glossEn: heat something before it is used
words.etymology: pre-（之前）+ heat（古英语 hǣtu）
derivation: pre（之前）+ heat（加热）→ preheat
words.example: Preheat the chamber to sixty degrees before the run.

words.etymology: 拉丁 pressura < premere（压），经古法语
derivation: press（压）+ ure（名词后缀：动作、结果）→ pressure
words.example: Pressure inside the tank rose faster than expected.

words.glossEn: advance showing before the public release
words.etymology: pre-（之前）+ view（古法语 veue < 拉丁 videre 看）
derivation: pre（之前）+ view（看）→ preview
words.example: The preview build crashed on the second launch.

words.etymology: pro-（向前）+ active < 拉丁 agere（做）
derivation: pro（向前）+ act（做）+ ive（形容词后缀）→ proactive
words.example: A proactive check caught the leak before the flight.

words.etymology: 拉丁 proficere（前进、有成效）< pro-（向前）+ facere（做）
derivation: pro（向前）+ fic（做，facere）+ ient（形容词后缀 -iens）→ proficient
words.example: She is proficient with both the mill and the lathe.

words.etymology: 希腊 programma < pro（在前）+ graphein（写）
derivation: pro（在前）+ gram（写下的东西）→ program 事先写好的东西
words.example: The program stops if a checksum fails.

words.etymology: 拉丁 progressus < pro-（向前）+ gradi（走）
derivation: pro（向前）+ gress（走）→ progress
words.example: Progress on the second site was slower than promised.

words.etymology: 拉丁 proles（后代）+ ferre（带来）→ proliferatio
derivation: proli（后代）+ fer（带来）+ ation（名词后缀）→ proliferation
words.example: Cheap nodes caused a proliferation of duplicate records.

words.glossEn: keep someone or something from harm
words.etymology: 拉丁 protegere < pro-（在前）+ tegere（覆盖）
derivation: pro（在前）+ tect（覆盖）→ protect 在前面盖住 → 保护
words.example: A shield protects the lens from the welding spatter.

words.etymology: 希腊 psychē（心灵）+ iatreia（治疗）
derivation: psych（心灵）+ iatr（治疗）+ y（学科名词后缀）→ psychiatry
words.example: Psychiatry and neurology share the same ward here.

words.glossEn: caused by the mind acting on the body
words.etymology: 希腊 psychē（心灵）+ sōma / sōmatos（身体）
derivation: psycho（心灵）+ somat（身体）+ ic（形容词后缀）→ psychosomatic
words.example: The rash was psychosomatic, not an allergy.

words.glossEn: extinct flying reptile with a long finger wing
words.etymology: 希腊 pteron（翅）+ daktylos（指）
derivation: pter（翅）+ o（连接元音）+ dactyl（指、趾）→ pterodactyl 翅长在指上
words.example: A pterodactyl cast hangs above the museum stairs.

words.etymology: 古法语 purchacier（追求、取得）< pur-（向前）+ chacier（追逐）
derivation: pur（向前）+ chase（追逐）→ purchase 追着要到手 → 购买
words.example: The team will purchase two more sensors next quarter.

words.glossEn: kept apart to stop a disease spreading
words.etymology: quarantine < 意大利 quarantina（四十天）< quaranta（四十），威尼斯港口防疫期
derivation: quarantine（隔离检疫）+ ed（形容词后缀）→ quarantined
words.example: The whole batch was quarantined after the first failure.

words.glossEn: at speed; in a short time
words.etymology: quick（古英语 cwic 活的）+ -ly
derivation: quick（快的）+ ly（副词后缀）→ quickly
words.example: The joint cooled quickly once the flow stopped.

words.etymology: 中世纪拉丁 reagere < re-（回）+ agere（做）
derivation: re（回）+ act（做、驱动）→ react 反过来做 → 反应
words.example: The coating reacts badly to salt spray.

words.glossEn: clear enough to be read easily
words.etymology: read（古英语 rǣdan）+ -able
derivation: read（读）+ able（能够被……的）→ readable
words.example: The log stays readable even after the crash.

words.etymology: re-（再）+ align（古法语 alignier < 拉丁 linea 线）
derivation: re（再）+ align（对齐）→ realign
words.example: Realign the mirrors before every measurement session.

words.glossEn: showing things as they really are
words.etymology: real（晚期拉丁 realis < res 事物）+ -istic
derivation: real（真实的）+ istic（形容词后缀：……特征的）→ realistic
words.example: The simulation gives a realistic estimate of drift.

words.etymology: re-（再）+ build（古英语 byldan）
derivation: re（再）+ build（建造）→ rebuild
words.example: Engineers had to rebuild the index from scratch.

words.etymology: re-（再）+ calibrate < calibre（口径）
derivation: re（再）+ calibr（校准）+ ate（动词后缀）→ recalibrate
words.example: Recalibrate the balance after each transport.

words.glossEn: remember; ask for something to be returned
words.etymology: re-（回）+ call（古英语 ceallian 呼喊）
derivation: re（回）+ call（呼喊）→ recall 叫回来 → 想起、召回
words.example: I cannot recall which batch failed first.

words.glossEn: container or socket that receives something
words.etymology: 拉丁 receptaculum < recipere（接收）< re- + capere（拿）
derivation: re（回）+ cept（拿，capere 的分词词干）+ acle（名词后缀：事物）→ receptacle
words.example: Wipe the receptacle before fitting a new probe.

words.etymology: 拉丁 regio < regere（统治、划界）
derivation: reg（统治、划界）+ ion（名词后缀）→ region 划定的范围
words.example: The northern region sees twice the rainfall.

words.glossEn: state of being even or repeated
words.etymology: regular + -ity < 拉丁 regularis < regula（尺、规则）
derivation: regular（规则的）+ ity（名词后缀）→ regularity
words.example: The regularity of the pulses suggests a clock fault.

words.etymology: regular + -ize，17 世纪
derivation: regular（规则的）+ ize（使……化）→ regularize
words.example: They agreed to regularize the naming of every module.

words.etymology: 拉丁 referre 的分词 relatus（带回、报告）> relatio
derivation: re（回）+ late（携带，ferre 的分词词干 lat-）→ relate 把两边带回来对上
words.example: The report relates the crack to a bad weld.

words.glossEn: quality of being able to be trusted
words.etymology: rely + -ability，-able 在派生中作 -abil-
derivation: rely（依靠）+ abil（-able 的变体）+ ity（名词后缀）→ reliability；y→i 拼写变化
words.example: Battery reliability decides the maintenance interval.

words.etymology: rely（古法语 relier < 拉丁 religare 绑紧）+ -able
derivation: rely（依靠）+ able（能够被……的）→ reliable；y→i 拼写变化
words.example: A cheap but reliable sensor beats a fragile one.

words.etymology: rely + -ance，17 世纪
derivation: rely（依靠）+ ance（名词后缀）→ reliance；y→i 拼写变化
words.example: Heavy reliance on one supplier caused the delay.

words.glossEn: able to be swapped for another
words.etymology: replace（re- + place）+ -able
derivation: replace（替换）+ able（能够被……的）→ replaceable
words.example: Every wear part is replaceable in under an hour.

words.glossEn: thing that takes the place of another
words.etymology: replace + -ment，18 世纪
derivation: replace（替换）+ ment（名词后缀）→ replacement
words.example: The replacement arrived with the wrong connector.

words.glossEn: relating to a state without a monarch
words.etymology: 拉丁 res publica（公共事务）> republicanus
derivation: re（事物，res）+ public（公众的，publicus）+ an（属于……的）→ republican
words.example: The city kept its republican charter for centuries.

words.etymology: 拉丁 resistere < re-（反）+ sistere（站住）
derivation: re（反）+ sist（站立、停住）→ resist 站着顶回去
words.example: The seal resists oil but not hot acid.

words.glossEn: ability to oppose a force; electrical opposition
words.etymology: 拉丁 resistentia < resistere
derivation: re（反）+ sist（站立）+ ance（名词后缀）→ resistance
words.example: Contact resistance rose after the connector corroded.

words.etymology: 拉丁 resistens，resistere 的现在分词
derivation: re（反）+ sist（站立）+ ant（形容词后缀）→ resistant
words.example: The alloy is resistant to salt but not to ammonia.

words.glossEn: applying to events in the past
words.etymology: retro-（向后）+ active < 拉丁 agere（做）
derivation: retro（向后）+ act（做）+ ive（形容词后缀）→ retroactive
words.example: The clause is retroactive to the first of January.

words.glossEn: add new parts to equipment already in use
words.etymology: retro-（向后）+ fit（装配）
derivation: retro（向后）+ fit（装配）→ retrofit 往回装到旧设备上
words.example: They will retrofit the old rig with new sensors.

words.etymology: 古法语 retorner < re-（回）+ torner（转）
derivation: re（回）+ turn（转）→ return 转回去
words.example: Return the probe to its case after use.

words.glossEn: write something again in a new form
words.etymology: re-（再）+ write（古英语 wrītan）
derivation: re（再）+ write（写）→ rewrite
words.example: We had to rewrite the parser after the format change.

words.glossEn: the act of operating or moving fast
words.etymology: run（古英语 rinnan 流动）+ -ing
derivation: run（跑、运转）+ ing（动名词后缀）→ running；n 双写
words.example: Running the model twice gave the same numbers.

words.glossEn: operates, or moves fast (third person singular)
words.etymology: run 的第三人称单数形式
derivation: run（运转）+ s（第三人称单数后缀）→ runs
words.example: The script runs in under two seconds.

words.glossEn: state of being free from danger
words.etymology: 古法语 sauveté < 拉丁 salvus（完好）
derivation: safe（安全的）+ ty（名词后缀，-ity 的缩短形式）→ safety
words.example: Safety checks run before every motor test.

words.glossEn: object that orbits a planet; a dependent state
words.etymology: 拉丁 satelles / satellitis（随从、卫兵）
derivation: satell（随从）+ ite（名词后缀）→ satellite 随从 → 卫星
words.example: The satellite downlinks the map twice a day.

words.glossEn: based on systematic observation and experiment
words.etymology: 晚期拉丁 scientificus < scientia（知识）+ facere（做）
derivation: sci（知道）+ ent（现在分词后缀，-ens） + ific（造成……的）→ scientific
words.example: There is no scientific support for that claim.

words.glossEn: withdraw formally from a group or state
words.etymology: 拉丁 secedere < se-（分开）+ cedere（走）
derivation: se（分开）+ cede（走，cedere）→ secede 走开 → 脱离
words.example: Two labs voted to secede from the consortium.

words.etymology: 拉丁 secludere < se-（分开）+ claudere（关）
derivation: se（分开）+ clude（关，claudere）→ seclude 关到一边
words.example: They seclude the reference unit from all vibration.

words.etymology: semi-（一半）+ circle < 拉丁 circulus
derivation: semi（一半）+ circle（圆）→ semicircle
words.example: The benches form a semicircle around the model.

words.glossEn: match that decides who reaches the final
words.etymology: semi-（一半）+ final < 拉丁 finalis < finis（终点）
derivation: semi（一半）+ final（决赛）→ semifinal
words.example: Their robot lost the semifinal by two points.

words.glossEn: quick to detect or react to small changes
words.etymology: 拉丁 sensitivus < sentire（感觉）
derivation: sens（感觉）+ itive（形容词后缀 -itivus）→ sensitive
words.example: The film is sensitive to green light only.

words.etymology: sensor < 拉丁 sentire（感觉）+ -or
derivation: sensor（传感器）+ s（复数后缀）→ sensors
words.example: Four sensors record the vibration of the frame.

words.glossEn: device that divides a mixture or stream
words.etymology: 拉丁 separare < se-（分开）+ parare（安排、准备）
derivation: se（分开）+ par（安排，parare）+ ator（名词后缀：装置）→ separator
注意：此处 par 取“安排”义（parare），与 parere“生育”同形异源
words.example: The cyclone separator traps dust before the filter.

words.glossEn: a sign, gesture or transmitted wave
words.etymology: 拉丁 signale < signum（记号）
derivation: sign（记号、标志）+ al（名词/形容词后缀）→ signal
words.example: The signal fades when the antenna tilts.

words.glossEn: large enough to matter; full of meaning
words.etymology: 拉丁 significans，significare（表示）的现在分词
derivation: sign（记号）+ ific（造成……的）+ ant（形容词后缀）→ significant
words.example: The drop in error rate was significant at p under 0.05.

words.etymology: simple（拉丁 simplex）+ -istic
derivation: simpl（简单，simplex）+ istic（形容词后缀）→ simplistic
words.example: That explanation is simplistic and ignores the weather.

words.glossEn: place something in a position or context
words.etymology: 中世纪拉丁 situare < situs（位置）
derivation: situ（位置、地点）+ ate（动词后缀）→ situate
words.example: The paper situates the method within robotics practice.

words.glossEn: make things conform to one standard
words.etymology: standard（古法语 estandart）+ -ize，19 世纪工业语境
derivation: standard（标准）+ ize（使……化）→ standardize
words.example: They standardize the bolt pattern across all units.

words.glossEn: the keeping of data or goods
words.etymology: store（古法语 estorer < 拉丁 instaurare 建立、储备）+ -age
derivation: stor（储存）+ age（名词后缀）→ storage
words.example: Storage fills up after about nine hours of video.

words.glossEn: person who studies at a school
words.etymology: 拉丁 students，studere（热心、钻研）的现在分词
derivation: stud（研习，studere）+ ent（形容词/名词后缀：具有……性质的人）→ student
words.example: Each student repeats the measurement three times.

words.etymology: sub-（在下面）+ standard（标准）
derivation: sub（在下面）+ standard（标准）→ substandard
words.example: Substandard solder caused two failures this month.

words.etymology: 拉丁 substantia（实质）< sub-（在下）+ stare（站）
derivation: sub（在下）+ stant（站立，stare 的分词词干）+ iate（动词后缀）→ substantiate
words.example: Two independent runs substantiate the reported gain.

words.etymology: 中世纪拉丁 substantiatio < substantiare
derivation: sub（在下）+ stant（站立）+ iation（名词后缀）→ substantiation
words.example: The paper asks for substantiation of every figure.

words.glossEn: character set above the normal line
words.etymology: super-（在上）+ script < 拉丁 scribere（写）
derivation: super（在上）+ script（写）→ superscript
words.example: Write the exponent as a superscript in the diagram.

words.glossEn: above the level of individual speech sounds
words.etymology: supra-（在上）+ segment < 拉丁 segmentum（切段）
derivation: supra（在上）+ segment（音段）+ al（形容词后缀）→ suprasegmental
words.example: Stress is a suprasegmental feature of the phrase.

words.etymology: 希腊 sympatheia < syn（共同）+ pathos（感受）
derivation: sym（syn- 在 p 前的同化，共同）+ path（感受）+ y（名词后缀）→ sympathy
words.example: She has little sympathy for careless calibration.

words.glossEn: make things happen at the same time
words.etymology: 希腊 synchronizein < syn（共同）+ khronos（时间）
derivation: syn（共同）+ chron（时间）+ ize（使……化）→ synchronize
words.example: Synchronize the two cameras before the first drop.

words.etymology: teach（古英语 tǣcan 指示）+ -ing
derivation: teach（教）+ ing（动名词后缀）→ teaching
words.example: Good teaching saves a week of debugging.

words.glossEn: relating to applied skills or machines
words.etymology: 希腊 tekhnikos < tekhnē（技艺）
derivation: techn（技艺）+ ical（形容词后缀）→ technical
words.example: The technical report lists every torque value.

words.etymology: 法语 technique < 希腊 tekhnē（技艺）
derivation: techn（技艺）+ ique（法语名词后缀）→ technique
words.example: This welding technique leaves almost no spatter.

words.etymology: 古法语 tenant，tenir（持有）的现在分词 < 拉丁 tenere
derivation: ten（握持、保持）+ ant（名词后缀：正在……的人）→ tenant 持有房屋的人
words.example: The tenant reported the broken window on Monday.

words.etymology: 拉丁 tenuis（细、薄）+ -ous
derivation: tenu（薄、细）+ ous（形容词后缀）→ tenuous
words.example: The link between the two faults is tenuous.

words.glossEn: end point; device for entering commands
words.etymology: 拉丁 terminalis < terminus（界石、终点）
derivation: termin（界限、终点）+ al（形容词/名词后缀）→ terminal
words.example: The terminal froze while the job was running.

words.etymology: 拉丁 terminare < terminus（终点）
derivation: termin（界限、终点）+ ate（动词后缀）→ terminate
words.example: Terminate the run before swapping the probe.

words.etymology: 希腊 tomos（切片）+ graphein（写）
derivation: tom（切）+ o（连接元音）+ graphy（记录、成像术）→ tomography
words.example: Computed tomography found the crack inside the blade.

words.etymology: 拉丁 trahere / tractus（拉）+ -or
derivation: tract（拉、拖）+ or（施动者）→ tractor
words.example: The tractor pulled the trailer off the wet field.

words.etymology: true（古英语 trēowe 忠实的）+ -ly
derivation: true（真实的）+ ly（副词后缀）→ truly；去 e 加 -ly
words.example: The result is truly independent of the operator.

words.etymology: 古英语 trēowþ < trēowe（忠实）+ -þu
derivation: true（真实的）+ th（名词后缀 -th）→ truth；去 e 加 -th
words.example: The truth came out only after the logs were read.

words.glossEn: below the surface of the earth
words.etymology: under（古英语 under）+ ground（古英语 grund）
derivation: under（在下）+ ground（地面）→ underground
words.example: The underground vault holds the reference masses.

words.glossEn: pay less than is fair or agreed
words.etymology: under-（不足）+ pay（古法语 paier < 拉丁 pacare 平息、偿付）
derivation: under（不足）+ pay（支付）→ underpay
words.example: The contractor tends to underpay the night crew.

words.glossEn: grasp of a subject or situation
words.etymology: understand（古英语 understandan 站在其中）+ -ing
derivation: understand（理解）+ ing（动名词后缀）→ understanding
words.example: A deeper understanding of the drift changed the design.

words.etymology: 晚期拉丁 unificare < unus（一）+ facere（做）
derivation: uni（单一）+ ify（使成为）→ unify；两个 i 合并为一个
words.example: They plan to unify the two file formats.

words.etymology: 拉丁 unus（一）+ latus / lateris（边）
derivation: uni（单一）+ later（边，latus 的词干 later-）+ al（形容词后缀）→ unilateral
注意：此处 later 取“边”义（latus, lateris），与 ferre 的分词 lat- 同形异源
words.example: A unilateral change of spec broke the interface.

words.glossEn: act of joining; a joined group
words.etymology: 教会拉丁 unio < 拉丁 unus（一）
derivation: uni（单一）+ on（名词后缀：事物、状态）→ union 合为一体
words.example: The union of the two datasets halved the gaps.

words.etymology: un-（不）+ limit（拉丁 limes / limitis 边界）+ -ed
derivation: un（不）+ limit（限制）+ ed（形容词后缀）→ unlimited
words.example: The trial account gives unlimited storage for a month.

words.etymology: un-（不）+ manage（意大利 maneggiare 驯马）+ -able
derivation: un（不）+ manage（管理）+ able（能够被……的）→ unmanageable
words.example: The cable bundle became unmanageable after the sixth run.

words.etymology: un-（不）+ reliable < rely + -able
derivation: un（不）+ rely（依靠）+ able（能够被……的）→ unreliable；y→i 拼写变化
words.example: An unreliable clock ruins every later measurement.

words.etymology: un-（相反动作）+ tie（古英语 tīgan 系）
derivation: un（相反动作）+ tie（系）→ untie
words.example: Untie the strap before you lift the case.

words.etymology: un-（不）+ true（古英语 trēowe）
derivation: un（不）+ true（真实的）→ untrue
words.example: The claim is untrue and easy to disprove.

words.etymology: 中世纪拉丁 verificare < verus（真）+ facere（做）
derivation: ver（真）+ ify（使成为）→ verify 使成真 → 核实
words.example: Verify the offset against a known mass.

words.glossEn: sensation that the world is spinning
words.etymology: 拉丁 vertigo < vertere（转）+ -igo（表状态、疾病）
derivation: vert（转）+ igo（名词后缀：状态、疾病）→ vertigo 天旋地转
words.example: Vertigo kept him off the ladder for two days.

words.etymology: 拉丁 vociferatio < vox / vocis（声音）+ ferre（带来）
derivation: voci（声音）+ fer（带来）+ ation（名词后缀）→ vociferation 把声音送出去
words.example: The vociferation outside drowned out the alarm.

words.etymology: 拉丁 volatilis < volare（飞）
derivation: volat（飞，volare 的分词词干）+ ile（形容词后缀：易于……的）→ volatile 容易飞走的
words.example: The solvent is volatile, so seal the jar.

words.etymology: voxel（volume + pixel 的混成词）+ -ized
derivation: voxel（体素）+ ized（形容词后缀）→ voxelized
words.example: The scan was voxelized at one millimetre resolution.

words.etymology: voxel 的复数；voxel 为 volume + pixel 的混成词
derivation: voxel（体素）+ s（复数后缀）→ voxels
words.example: Empty voxels are dropped before the mesh is built.

words.etymology: walk（古英语 wealcan 滚动、翻动）+ -ed
derivation: walk（走）+ ed（过去式后缀）→ walked
words.example: She walked the whole perimeter before the survey.

words.etymology: whole（古英语 hāl 完整、健康）+ -some，12 世纪
derivation: whole（完整、健康）+ some（形容词后缀：具有……性质的）→ wholesome
words.example: The canteen serves wholesome food at low cost.

words.etymology: whole + -ly，中古英语 holliche
derivation: whole（完整的）+ ly（副词后缀）→ wholly；去 e 加 -ly
words.example: The failure was wholly due to a loose ground.

words.etymology: wire（古英语 wīr）+ -less，20 世纪初指无线电
derivation: wire（导线）+ less（没有……的）→ wireless
words.example: The wireless link drops whenever the door closes.
